title: Dust In The Void: Lunar Combat Flight Simulator
author: PropertyRemote2332
selftext:
I'm developing Dust in the Void. It's about suborbital flight and combat on the moon in 2060. Factions are competing for scarce resources in a small region of the moon. You are a mercenary for hire trying not to die. This latest update introduces missiles, rockets, countermeasures, and ground combat. Love to get your feedback!

This game is developed using Codex + Blender + UE5 and decades of aerospace + software engineering experience.

Feel free to join our discord server for updates and to share your opinions!
